name: com.einvoicechecker/einvoice
title: E-Invoice Checker
description: Validate, parse, fix and render e-invoices: XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, Peppol, KSeF, Facturae, MyInvois

tools.name: list_supported_formats
tools.description: Which formats, profiles and rule sets this service supports, and what each tool costs.

tools.name: detect_invoice
tools.description: Identify the format, syntax, profile/customization and country standard of an e-invoice file. Cheap first step before validating.

content.description: Invoice XML (UBL, CII, XRechnung, Peppol BIS, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML, KSeF FA(3)) as text

content_base64.description: A ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (or any invoice file) as base64, when the invoice is not plain XML

tools.name: parse_invoice
tools.description: Extract the invoice as normalised JSON: number, dates, seller, buyer, lines, VAT breakdown, totals, payment details. Works for every supported format.

content.description: Invoice XML (UBL, CII, XRechnung, Peppol BIS, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML, KSeF FA(3)) as text

content_base64.description: A ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (or any invoice file) as base64, when the invoice is not plain XML

tools.name: fix_invoice
tools.description: Fix validation errors of an EN 16931 invoice (XRechnung, Peppol BIS, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML, UBL, CII) deterministically: empty elements, decimals, date and code formats, specification ids; with totals=true also recalculates totals and the VAT breakdown from the lines. Data that is not in the file (Leitweg-ID, seller contact, endpoint ids, payment terms) is taken from "values"; missing ones are listed in needs_input. Returns the change list, the remaining errors and the corrected XML. Counts as 2 requests.

content.description: Invoice XML (UBL, CII, XRechnung, Peppol BIS, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML, KSeF FA(3)) as text

content_base64.description: A ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (or any invoice file) as base64, when the invoice is not plain XML

totals.description: Allow recalculating document totals and VAT breakdown from the line amounts

sellerContactName.description: Seller contact person (BT-41), e.g. Max Mustermann

sellerEndpoint.description: Seller electronic address (BT-34), scheme:value, e.g. EM:billing@example.com

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms (BT-20), e.g. Zahlbar innerhalb 30 Tagen ohne Abzug

values.description: Values for data that is missing in the file

tools.name: validate_invoice
tools.description: Run the official rule set for the detected format (KoSIT for XRechnung/ZUGFeRD/Factur-X, OpenPeppol for Peppol BIS, FA(3) schema for KSeF, Porezna uprava HR-CIUS schematron for Croatian eRačun, Facturae XSD + calculation/NIF/DIR3 rules for Spain, LHDN SDK rules for MyInvois). Returns valid/invalid with every failed rule: id, severity, message, XPath.

content.description: Invoice XML (UBL, CII, XRechnung, Peppol BIS, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML, KSeF FA(3)) as text

content_base64.description: A ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (or any invoice file) as base64, when the invoice is not plain XML

kosit.description: Run the full KoSIT schematron (default true). false = schema and core checks only, faster

tools.name: render_invoice_html
tools.description: Human-readable invoice document (HTML, A4 print layout) from the XML, in the requested language.

content.description: Invoice XML (UBL, CII, XRechnung, Peppol BIS, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML, KSeF FA(3)) as text

content_base64.description: A ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (or any invoice file) as base64, when the invoice is not plain XML

tools.name: render_invoice_pdf
tools.description: Human-readable PDF of the invoice (counts as 2 requests). Returned as a base64 resource.

content.description: Invoice XML (UBL, CII, XRechnung, Peppol BIS, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML, KSeF FA(3)) as text

content_base64.description: A ZUGFeRD / Factur-X PDF (or any invoice file) as base64, when the invoice is not plain XML

lang.description: Label language of the PDF, e.g. "de"; default en

tools.name: repair_xml
tools.description: Repair an invoice XML that is not well-formed (validate/parse answer MALFORMED_XML): closes unclosed elements, removes stray closing tags, fixes prefix/case mismatches, escapes bare & and <. Refuses truncated files, HTML and files needing more than 25 changes (REPAIR_NOT_POSSIBLE). Returns every change and the repaired XML; validate it before sending. XML only, not PDF.

content.description: Invoice XML (UBL, CII, XRechnung, Peppol BIS, ZUGFeRD/Factur-X XML, KSeF FA(3)) as text
